integrity: The theorem is derived from exact set-structure arguments and Stirling-number counting. A separate direct graph-level enumerator checked every vertex partition and coalition graph for one through five blades; finite replay is corroboration, not proof of all orders.
scientific_limitations: Complete classification concerns friendship graphs formed from triangles sharing a single apex, not larger-blade windmills or arbitrary cactus graphs.
The one-blade triangle is a known boundary case; uniqueness of an extremal partition is asserted only for at least two blades.
Historical priority beyond the cited and indexed comparisons is provisional; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: Complete total restrained coalition-partition spectrum of friendship graphs
